architecture: Python/Jupyter master workflow + Earth Engine server-side backend

process_stages.name: Upstream Setup and Source Contract
process_stages.role: AOI, upstream source registry, preprocessing contract and core input preparation.

process_stages.name: Baseline and Monitoring Stacks
process_stages.role: Period-matched baseline and 2025 monitoring feature stacks including optical/radar evidence.

process_stages.name: Temporal Anomaly
process_stages.role: Period anomaly layers derived from matched baseline versus monitoring evidence.

process_stages.name: Core Condition / Risk
process_stages.role: Core optical-radar condition and inspection-risk product including balanced class rules.

process_stages.name: Contextual Enrichment
process_stages.role: Age, rainfall, atmosphere, ET/PET, terrain, hydrology, soil and soil-water reusable context.

process_stages.name: Feature Screening and Calibration
process_stages.role: Correlation/VIF, spatial CV, context ablation, feature selection, family weights, calibration and fusion sensitivity.

process_stages.name: Integrated Inspection Priority
process_stages.role: Wall-to-wall F05 contextual integration, evidence-gated class transitions and final QA.

process_stages.name: Analytical Freeze
process_stages.role: Final product statistics, class schema, legend, map preview, metadata and freeze manifest.

process_stages.name: Web Delivery
process_stages.role: COG raster delivery plus metadata, tables, legend and web-development package.

process_stages.name: Complete Reproducible Package
process_stages.role: Master notebook, reusable AOI runner, complete inventory, provenance, backup and handover.
